SPR-154.title: Poker-theory gap batch #1 — fix the §3.4 taxonomy hole, then build the instrument that measures the rest
SPR-154.goal:
Open the WS-272..WS-280 batch with one correctness fix and one instrument.

WS-278 ships real correctness cheaply: POKER_THEORY §3.4 asserts an exhaustive
taxonomy of betting motivations and omits protection / equity denial, so
actionClassifier + weaknessDetector actively MISFILE correctly-played
protection bets as either thin value (villain looks like they over-value) or
as bluffs (villain looks like they over-bluff). Both misreads point hero the
wrong way and both accumulate into the villain model as evidence for a leak
that does not exist. It is also the proof case for WS-272 — the code
faithfully implements a doc that is itself incomplete, so no code-vs-doc sweep
could ever have found it.

WS-273 is the instrument. Every remaining item in the batch (274, 275, 277,
279) has "measure it via WS-273" written into its acceptance criteria.
Building it second means the rest of the batch gets evaluated rather than
argued, and it is the empirical arm of WS-272's outward-facing check.

Deliberately NOT leading with WS-274 despite its 26 anchor score: it is an L
with three open decisions, and running it after the harness lets us actually
test whether table-composition-derived advice predicts better than the chart
it replaces. Founder-approved sequencing, 2026-07-26.
